MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Exile On Main Street felt like a natural next choice because its bluesy, guitar-driven rock connects with what appealed to me in Clapton and Hendrix.",
    "Santana and Bob Seger also felt relevant because expressive guitar playing and rootsy rock appeal to me right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Donovan, Neil Diamond, and the Lovin' Spoonful felt less relevant because lighter folk and pop sounds do not satisfy my current interest in bluesy rock.",
    "Blown Away gives some reason to suggest country, but it does not mean I am currently looking for an outlaw-country collection.",
    "The Beatles and the Nashville compilation had some appeal, but a live recording or a compilation was less compelling today than Exile On Main Street."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seemed to treat familiar older artists as broadly interchangeable, while the sound and guitar playing matter more to me than their era.",
    "The many greatest-hits collections seemed to assume that recognizing an artist would make a broad collection my next choice."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Clapton and Hendrix listening points toward blues influences and expressive guitar work, which explain my strongest choice better than a general interest in classic rock.",
    "I rarely choose several things in one visit, so finding other albums relevant does not mean I would select them alongside my first choice."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in classic and rootsy rock, but spread too broadly beyond the bluesy guitar sound I wanted today."
}
